subject: English
question_text: Fill in the gaps with suitable prepositions, articles and zero articles (a, an, the or x): 0.
stimulus: It is needless to say that washing hands is very important for us. It is certainly (a) ___ important issue. Washing hands regularly can save us from a kind of infectious disease (b) ___ COVID-19. Washing hands with soap is (c) ___ must. We have to wash hands (d) ___ taking meal and (e) ___ using the toilet. Again, we should wash hands after touching sick members (f) ___ our family and pet animals. Washing hands is also strictly recommended after coming back (g) ___ outside. Washing hands in (h) ___ proper way may help us stay away from corona virus. (i) ___ reason is that corona virus spreads through touch. So, it is (j) ___ important to keep our hands clean.
guide_solution: (a) an (b) like (c) a (d) before (e) after (f) of (g) from (h) a (i) the (j) ×
